versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Unit Test Coverage Helper skill.
- Provides repeatable guidance for adding useful unit tests and increasing test coverage in existing codebases.
- Delivers practical workflows, scripts, templates, and checklists with a focus on local and CPU-friendly solutions.
- Outputs include tailored guidance, reusable processes, and verification notes to improve confidence in software changes.
- Activated via keywords such as “unit tests,” “test coverage,” and “regression.”
